 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. The Chicago Bulls are on the road Friday afternoon as they travel to take on the Milwaukee Bucks in an Eastern Conference matchup.
 Chicago enters Friday's game with an 0-1 record after losing on the road to the Toronto Raptors Wednesday night.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Chicago Bulls forward Matas Buzelis (14)© Kamil Krzaczynski-Imagn Images
 In Wednesday's loss, Matas Buzelis led the way for the Bulls as he recorded 17 points and six rebounds while Jalen Smith added 15 points and eight rebounds of his own.
 The Bulls will try to bounce back Friday as they face off against the Bucks in a tough road matchup.
 Milwaukee enters Friday's contest with an 0-1 record after losing on the road to the Washington Wizards Wednesday night.
 Milwaukee Bucks guard Tyler Herro (11)Scott Kinser-Imagn Images
 Tyler Herro led the way for the Bucks in Wednesday's loss as he ended the game with 24 points and nine assists while Jaime Jaquez Jr. recorded 22 points and seven rebounds.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement While both teams are looking to pick up a victory in Friday afternoon's matchup, one may be without multiple key players due to injuries.
 Bulls Injury Report: Will Josh Giddey, Nic Claxton Play?
 Chicago Bulls guard Josh GiddeyDavid Banks-Imagn Images
 The Bulls have six players listed on their injury report, including Josh Giddey and Nic Claxton.
 Chicago has listed Giddey as probable and he is expected to play despite dealing with a left wrist sprain.
 The Bulls have also listed Zach Collins as probable due to a right quad strain while Tobe Awaka is probable with a left MCL sprain. Both players are expected to play.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Claxton has been ruled out due to a left hamstring strain as he will miss his second straight game to begin the season and he is expected to miss at least two more weeks with the injury.
 Chicago Bulls center Nic Claxton (9)Matt Marton-Imagn Images
 Jordan Hawkins and Dailyn Swain have been listed as questionable as both players are dealing with illnesses.
 Bucks Injury Report
 The Bucks enter Friday's game with a healthy roster as they have nobody listed on their injury report.
 This is great news for Milwaukee as the team tries to grab their first victory of the season over the Bulls.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Fans can catch Friday afternoon's matchup between the Bulls and Bucks from Fiserv Forum at 4 p.m. ET.
